relationships.subject: general anesthetics
relationships.evidence_quote: general anesthetics seem to converge on a few shared processes which in one way or another destabilize dendritic spines and stimulate synaptic remodeling

relationships.subject: CaMKII
relationships.evidence_quote: with the Ca2+calmodulin-dependent kinase II (CaMKII) playing a key role in controlling molecular processes underlying the stability and dynamics of the cytoskeletal protein actin, governing the dynamics of dendritic spine remodeling and plasticity

relationships.subject: cofilin
relationships.evidence_quote: cofilin, when activated, causes severing of polymerizing actin with shrinkage of dendritic spines

relationships.subject: isoflurane
relationships.evidence_quote: exposure of neuronal culture to isoflurane inhibits the release of synaptic tissue-type plasminogen activator (tPA), promotes the pro-BDNF, and reduces the mature BDNF (mBDNF) signaling

key_findings: Review: general anesthetics destabilize dendritic spines and stimulate synaptic remodeling via Ca2+/CaMKII, Rho GTPase/cofilin pathways
Isoflurane depletes F-actin in spines and reduces mBDNF signaling
